english.note: Use this construction when describing the frightening effect on a particular person, often followed by that person's resulting state.

examples.english: Those scenes frighten me so much that I can't sleep.
examples.traditional: 嗰啲畫面嚇到我瞓唔着。
examples.jyutping: go2 di1 waa6 min6 haak3 dou3 ngo5 fan3 m4 zoek6
